name: runSingleCheck
description: Runs ONE check for validateChecks. Input: { check: {name,node,command,expect,phase,nedExec?} }. Executes the command via NSO live-status exec/any (generic.rest connector against the nsoRest resource, which auto-injects basic-auth from the cwm.sol.system.nso secret), extracts the raw CLI output into .rawOutput, then computes the PASS/FAIL verdict in a state-level output filter where .check is in scope (regex match of output against check.expect). Returns { name,node,command,expect,phase,output,verdict }. Must be a separate child workflow because a foreach action's results filter cannot see the iterationParam .check.

definition.name: runSingleCheck

stateDataFilter.output: ${ { name: .check.name, node: .check.node, command: .check.command, expect: .check.expect, phase: .check.phase, output: .rawOutput } | . + { verdict: ( .expect as $exp | if ( (.output // "") | test($exp) ) then "PASS" else "FAIL" end ) } }
